# pet.txt — runtime format (generated by petforge, read by Go and Java engines)

Line based, fields separated by TAB. Expressions are kept as strings and evaluated
at runtime (same grammar as desktopPet animations.xsd `expressionType`).

```
V	1
NAME	<title>
IMG	<tilesx>	<tilesy>	<cellW>	<cellH>     # sprite.png is RGBA, already transparent
S	<id>	<prob>	<nextId>	<xExpr>	<yExpr>      # spawn
A	<id>	<name>                                 # starts an animation block
ST	<xExpr>	<yExpr>	<offsetY>	<opacity>	<intervalExpr>
EN	<xExpr>	<yExpr>	<offsetY>	<opacity>	<intervalExpr>
Q	<repeatExpr>	<repeatFrom>	<action: none|flip>
F	<frame> <frame> ...                        # space separated
N	<prob>	<only>	<id>                         # next after sequence
B	<prob>	<only>	<id>                         # next on border hit
G	<prob>	<only>	<id>                         # next on gravity (airborne)
```

`only` is one of: none, taskbar, window, windowSide, horizontal, horizontal+,
vertical, vertical+, petSide. Frames are numbered row-major in sprite.png.
Special animation names (case-insensitive): `drag`, `fall`.
